response.sql: WITH matched AS (SELECT ab.translink, tr.ordertypedist FROM advancedbehavior ab INNER JOIN transactionrecord tr ON tr.transreg = ab.translink WHERE ab.peercorr >= 0.149 AND tr.ordertypedist IS NOT NULL), grouped AS (SELECT translink, ordertypedist, COUNT(*) as cnt FROM matched GROUP BY translink, ordertypedist), totals AS (SELECT ordertypedist, SUM(cnt) as total_count FROM grouped GROUP BY ordertypedist) SELECT g.translink, g.ordertypedist, g.cnt, CAST(g.cnt AS REAL) / t.total_count as fraction FROM grouped g JOIN totals t ON g.ordertypedist = t.ordertypedist ORDER BY fraction DESC LIMIT 10
